$comment: One entry per Pi package. source=npm: packages/<dir> holds the exact published tarball contents. source=git: packages/<dir> holds only the listed paths at the pinned commit. source=local: our own code in local/<dir>. Local changes to upstream packages live in patches/<dir>/*.patch.

decide.review: Written for this setup (plan modeles-routage, phase B; 0.2.0: reads the gateway from Pi, no launcher). No dependencies, no install scripts. Only network call: POST <magpie baseUrl>/systemone (group/decide) with the key of Pi's `magpie` provider, resolved through ctx.modelRegistry (models.json + auth.json). Reads and writes no file.

integrity.contentSha256Method: cd packages/infisical-ai-skills && find . -type f | sort | xargs shasum -a 256 | shasum -a 256

infisical-ai-skills.review: Markdown only (17 files: 3 SKILL.md, 13 references, LICENSE): no scripts, no executable files. Commands quoted are the official CLI installers (artifacts-cli.infisical.com, curl|bash in Docker/CI examples), `npx skills add`, `pip install infisicalsdk`; some lines still cite dl.cloudsmith.io, retired on 2026-09-16. No hidden instructions found. Our rules live in pi-agent skills/infisical, which takes precedence.
